752db44ba0fc: <cmd6>This system maintains orderly<nl>traffic by placing all of Neo<nl>Kobe's roads, waterways, and air<nl>routes under Alphaville's control.<nl>Combined with Advanced Safety<nl>Vehicles (ASVs), it eliminated<nl>road accidents and congestion,<nl>making traffic problems a thing of<nl>the past. ed9427ebf830: <cmd6>World War III (2005-2006)<end>August 24, 2005: World War III<nl>breaks out over the UN Neutral<nl>Territory, which had served as the<nl>world's largest buffer zone for<nl>ten years after the Catastrophe.<end>China provides military support to<nl>right-wing remnants of the former<nl>Soviet army who escaped the<nl>Catastrophe, helping them invade<nl>the neutral zone.<end>Western economic sanctions quickly<nl>force China to withdraw, securing<nl>victory for UN forces.<end>The war ends after just six<nl>months, earning it the name<nl>"Half-Year War."
41470275e844: <cmd6>'Siberian Neutral Territory'<end>>Emptied by the catastrophe,<nl>Siberia is run by the UN and<nl>abandoned as a non-intervention<nl>zone for fifty years.<nl>The aftereffects of 'Lucifer<nl>Alpha' leave no animal or plant<nl>able to grow there for half a<nl>century.<end>>So that nothing like 'World War<nl>III' happens twice, the UN keeps<nl>the peace of the neutral zone<nl>by sending a 'Siberian survey<nl>team' every year to watch over it.<nl>Observation posts are set up here<nl>and there as well.
df1e86a02ece: <cmd6>'Nuclear Abolition'<end>>Beginning with the INF treaty of<nl>1987, strategic and tactical<nl>nuclear arms were cut back...<nl>and with the IAEA's 'agreement to<nl>halt the production of<nl>weapons-grade fissile<nl>material'...<nl>military nuclear arms were rooted<nl>out early this century, and the<nl>nuclear threat has vanished.
3eed33d13d03: <cmd6>'The Witch Hunt' (Bioroid Hunt)<end>>A social phenomenon born of the<nl>Snatcher problem.<end>In their terror of Snatchers,<nl>crowds turned hysterically<nl>violent, calling innocent people<nl>Snatchers and killing them.<nl>The victims were mainly the<nl>socially weak.<end>The name comes from the medieval<nl>witch hunts.<end>>Worst of all, tied to the<nl>north-south divide, citizens of<nl>the 'north' attacked the slum<nl>dwellers of the 'south' in mobs...<nl>a movement fused with anti-slum<nl>feeling, and many with no link to<nl>Snatchers lost their lives.<nl>>The 'witch hunt' died down once<nl>it was learned that only important<nl>people were snatched.
c9430f935437: <cmd6>JUNKER's Organization<end>JUNKER consists of a Chief, called<nl>the Head or Brain, a Mechanic, an<nl>Operator, field investigators<nl>called Runners, and support robots<nl>called Navigators who accompany<nl>the Runners. A forensic division<nl>called JUNK provides additional<nl>support.<end>The Mechanic develops and<nl>maintains all equipment used by<nl>JUNKER.<end>The Operator processes all<nl>incoming data, including<nl>transmissions from Navigators.<end>The Head monitors the entire<nl>situation and directs the Runners.<end>Runners use Navigators to conduct<nl>investigations in the field,<nl>taking on the dangerous work.<end>JUNK handles the follow-up work at<nl>scenes after the Runners finish.

3f10687b65e4: <cmd6>The Five JUNKER Rules<end>The basic rules governing JUNKER<nl>conduct fall into five articles.<end>1. JUNKER's purpose is to<nl>eliminate the bioroids known as<nl>Snatchers.<end>2. JUNKER must not harm humans,<nl>even when carrying out Article 1.<end>3. Under Civil Code Article 18,<nl>Section 12, "Human Rights<nl>Protection in Snatcher Cases,"<nl>JUNKERs may not directly<nl>investigate or physically restrain<nl>suspects without conclusive<nl>evidence that they are Snatchers.<end>4. Under Criminal Code Special<nl>Provision 3, "Assistance to Bounty<nl>Hunters," JUNKER must cooperate<nl>with and support civilian bounty<nl>hunters.<end>5. JUNKER personnel are specially<nl>authorized to carry Blasters and<nl>use Navigators to carry out<nl>Article 1.
c42162484f31: <cmd6>Scanning Warrants<end>Civil Code Article 18, Section 12,<nl>"Human Rights Protection in<nl>Snatcher Cases," gives citizens<nl>the right to refuse direct<nl>examination, or scanning, by<nl>JUNKER.<end>JUNKER may perform direct<nl>scientific examination, or direct<nl>scanning, only upon presentation<nl>of a scanning warrant issued by a<nl>court.<end>Until a warrant is issued,<nl>scientific scanning of individuals<nl>with any kind of sensor is<nl>prohibited.
3558ef8918e4: <cmd6>JUNKER Runners are frequently<nl>wounded. They use two forms of<nl>blood replacement to improve their<nl>chances of survival and reduce<nl>fatalities.<end>(1) Artificial blood replacement<nl>The Runner's own blood is replaced<nl>with artificial blood and stored<nl>for transfusion as needed.<nl>Artificial blood can be produced<nl>and transfused in unlimited<nl>quantities, eliminating the danger<nl>of excessive blood loss.<end>However, filtering artificial<nl>blood strains the kidneys, making<nl>dialysis necessary.<end>(2) Frozen blood replacement<nl>(autologous blood doping)<nl>The Runner's own blood is enriched<nl>with expensive nutrients,<nl>concentrated, and stored at minus<nl>42 degrees Celsius. It is thawed<nl>and transfused back into the<nl>Runner as needed.
be394bcb8dae: <cmd6>Chewing gum with adrenaline in it,<nl>issued to JUNKERs.<end>A military article meant to supply<nl>adrenaline in an emergency; it<nl>drew notice in World War III.<end>The adrenaline lifts a JUNKER's<nl>stability, reflexes and stamina in<nl>a crisis.<nl>Long use brings side effects:<nl>lethargy and fatigue. The trade<nl>calls it 'bottled hysterical<nl>strength'.
deb952667403: <cmd6>Analytical robots that support<nl>Runners' investigations.<end>Navigators handle analysis,<nl>recording, and communications to<nl>keep JUNKER investigations running<nl>smoothly. Each is programmed to<nl>suit its Runner's personality and<nl>provide psychological support<nl>during their stressful work. They<nl>also carry a range of sensors to<nl>detect all kinds of danger.<end>Once a scanning warrant has been<nl>issued, they can scan the human<nl>body.<end>Without a warrant, however, a<nl>control circuit blocks all<nl>commands to perform such scans.
0cebc97c077e: <cmd6>The only firearm capable of<nl>eliminating a Snatcher.<end>Its body is made from advanced<nl>engineering plastic, carbon fiber,<nl>and ceramic. It is extremely light<nl>and resists deformation from<nl>temperature changes.<end>The grip and trigger are<nl>ergonomically designed to fit the<nl>user's hand.<end>A feedback mechanism lets it fire<nl>as fast as the user's reflexes<nl>allow, with no upper limit.
870d7067f587: <cmd6>'Snatchers: Known Facts'<end>1) Snatchers act in winter, and<nl>by night.<end>2) Snatchers snatch only VIPs.<nl>Their aim seems to lie not in the<nl>snatch itself but in its secondary<nl>effects. 3) A Snatcher's<nl>snatching ability has limits. The<nl>contraction of its parts, joints<nl>and frame follows certain<nl>standards. The range is reckoned<nl>to be 150 to 180 cm in<nl>height.<end>From this, children and the old<nl>are thought to be beyond<nl>snatching.<end>4) Snatcher weapon: a laser<nl>cannon in the mouth.<end>5) Snatcher weak point: the<nl>thin armour at the slit in the<nl>head.
f5db2b6d1e68: <cmd6>Bounty Hunter System<end>At the end of 2041, the<nl>Metropolitan Police introduced the<nl>following bounty system to enlist<nl>public help in eliminating<nl>Snatchers.<end>Any Kobe citizen eligible to vote<nl>may register as a bounty hunter by<nl>completing a simple application<nl>process, including proof of<nl>firearm ownership, psychological<nl>testing, and a JUNKER test.<end>The reward for eliminating a<nl>Snatcher is determined by the<nl>circumstances.<end>Registered hunters also receive<nl>substantial insurance coverage for<nl>accidents that occur during their<nl>work.
ef4bd41b191f: <cmd6>'The Founding of the City'<end>Late in the 20th century, work<nl>began on the chain of artificial<nl>islands in the Inland Sea: Port<nl>Island, Rokko Island, the new Kobe<nl>international airport.<nl>Early in the 21st century the<nl>'Neo Kobe City Plan' set out to<nl>unite the five island blocks into<nl>one.<nl>Ten years on it was finished,<nl>together with the Kobe Expo. It<nl>started as a new international<nl>artificial city, taking in mass<nl>migration from Asia.<nl>By 2040 it had earned its<nl>evil name as the world's worst<nl>city for crime, 'Crimeville'.
c608a4a95454: <cmd6>The central computer system that<nl>governs and manages Neo Kobe City.<end>It links hundreds of computers<nl>throughout the city to simulate<nl>the neural circuits of the human<nl>brain. This large-scale, massively<nl>parallel neurocomputer is capable<nl>of extremely fast processing.<end>As the city's center for<nl>information storage and control,<nl>it holds data on every individual,<nl>company, and organization, and<nl>manages everyday finance,<nl>distribution, and transportation.
8bd973df7c8f: <cmd6>A cedar variety bred by gene<nl>manipulation.<end>Developed for military use; its<nl>pollen badly disrupts radio.<end>It is harmful to the body as<nl>well: breathe in much of it and<nl>the airways suffer...<end>and even a little brings on<nl>allergies, sneezing and a running<nl>nose.<end>The pollen is larger than ordinary<nl>cedar and looks like snow, hence<nl>the name snow cedar.<end>It breeds strongly and harms the<nl>environment, so removal work after<nl>the war was brisk and the numbers<nl>fell.<nl>Even now, though, it grows in<nl>numbers wherever water is<nl>plentiful, along rivers from<nl>temperate to cold climates.<end>In the city, snow cedar is<nl>confirmed only in the Ina river<nl>basin.<end>Because the pollen is found<nl>wherever Snatchers have been at<nl>work, the link between the two<nl>draws growing attention.
bfbcc69dc255: <cmd6>A disease of unknown nature,<nl>spreading since 2030, chiefly<nl>in France.<end>In Neo Kobe the first patient was<nl>confirmed in the summer of<nl>2035.<end>Today the recognised STBO patients<nl>are said to number fifty thousand,<nl>or a hundred thousand.<end>Infection brings fever, joint and<nl>muscle pain, diarrhoea, swollen<nl>lymph nodes, convulsions and<nl>pneumonia together, and the<nl>fatality rate passes 60%.<nl>It is confirmed to pass through<nl>blood, saliva and semen,<end>and is thought to be caught most<nl>often through sexual contact or<nl>intravenous injection, above all<nl>in taking stimulants.<nl>One view holds it a mutation of<nl>the 'AIDS' virus (human T-cell<nl>leukaemia virus) that spread<nl>fifty years ago, but no treatment<nl>has been found.<end>Through this virus, communication<nl>between people has broken down...<end>and in a sense that has been one<nl>cause of the Snatchers' spread.
df0dd8ea8ec0: <cmd6>A new alkaloid hallucinogen, a<nl>tripper drug.<end>Taken by mouth or injected into<nl>vein or skin. It acts strongly on<nl>the nervous system, bringing<nl>excitement and disturbed vision.<end>Synthesised on the model of the<nl>brain's own substances, it works<nl>above all to take anxiety and fear<nl>out of the mind...<nl>and since the late 2030s it<nl>has spread explosively among the<nl>young.<end>Because it suppresses the brain's<nl>own secretions, tolerance builds,<nl>and stopping can leave the central<nl>nerves failing.
6906744f8d4c: <cmd6>The illegal marketplace in Neo<nl>Kobe City.<end>As an unauthorized market, it<nl>offers a wide range of goods, both<nl>legal and illegal. An influx of<nl>Chinese immigrants with strong<nl>business skills greatly expanded<nl>the black market.<end>It is even said to be larger than<nl>the legal market.<end>Its customers were mainly<nl>immigrants from the continent and<nl>people who entered illegally,<nl>making it a market for the<nl>underground economy. Recently, its<nl>size and low prices have also<nl>attracted many ordinary citizens,<nl>hurting the legal market.<end><cmd3>Joy Division<cmd6> is Neo Kobe's largest<nl>black market district.
8b6af4ff3e62: <cmd6>A linear motor train using<nl>superconductivity.<end>It carried the city's traffic for<nl>forty years after the war, then<nl>closed as the 'south' became slums<nl>and the 'automatic traffic system'<nl>arrived.<nl>The first plan was to run the<nl>train in a near-vacuum tube,<nl>bringing air resistance close to<nl>zero...<nl>but rising cost and the soft<nl>ground of the artificial islands<nl>kept it from being built.<end>The tunnels of the closed tube<nl>liner still run beneath the city<nl>as they were.<nl>Since then, what with land<nl>ownership and the ground itself,<nl>the tube liner remains have been<nl>left untouched.
eee7030a342b: <cmd6>An illegal manned taxi.<end>Ordinarily a 'taxi' means the<nl>computer-controlled driverless<nl>kind...<end>but a driverless taxi cannot be<nl>boarded without proof of<nl>citizenship, and can only be used<nl>inside the information control<nl>zone...<nl>and since it records where you get<nl>on and off, many immigrants and<nl>illegal entrants cannot use it.<end>An 'unlicensed taxi', by contrast,<nl>asks nothing of its passenger...<end>and can travel anywhere in the<nl>city, which is why passengers<nl>favour it.<end>So, illegal though they are,<nl>'unlicensed taxis' operate openly<nl>and even organise themselves, and<nl>cannot be ignored. The government<nl>is moving towards licensing these<nl>illegal operators after review,<nl>and making them legal.
5a3302153a87: <cmd6>Late in the 20th century the<nl>idea of sending mankind into space<nl>was raised...<end>and the worsening of the earth's<nl>environment, global warming and<nl>biohazards, spurred it on.<end>With the American space station<nl>'Freedom' and the development of<nl>fusion rockets, mankind's advance<nl>into space came on by great<nl>strides.<nl>Today a lunar base mining<nl>helium-3 for fusion is at work,<nl>and the advance into the 'new<nl>colony' on Mars goes forward.
f8162d7cce51: <cmd6>Mars Exploration Data<end>August 1988: The former Soviet<nl>Union's Phobos Project sends<nl>Phobos 1 and 2 to survey Mars and<nl>its moons, Phobos and Deimos.<end>October 1989: America's Mars<nl>Observer probe surveys the Martian<nl>climate and soil.<end>1992: Project Vesta explores Mars,<nl>asteroids, and comets. Originally<nl>led by Eastern European nations,<nl>it received American support after<nl>the chaos of the Catastrophe.<end>2005: Work begins on Wells, an<nl>automated robot factory on Mars.<end>2010: An orbital transfer craft<nl>for Mars personnel begins<nl>operations.<end>2015: Work begins on Le Guin, a<nl>crewed experimental base.<end>2022: Work begins on McCaffrey<nl>Spaceport on Mars.<end>2025: Dick, the first Mars base,<nl>is completed.<end>2030: Burroughs, a full-scale Mars<nl>base, begins operations.<end>2035: Asimov, the first mine on<nl>Mars, begins operations.
400fdfc5a83d: <cmd6>'The Greening of Mars'<end>A plan to turn the empty planet<nl>Mars into a land green as the<nl>earth.<end>First, mirrors are set in Martian<nl>orbit to increase the sunlight<nl>falling on the surface, while<nl>greenhouse gases are spread<nl>below...<nl>warming Mars until yeasts and<nl>bacteria can live there.<end>Then the oxygen those yeasts and<nl>cells give off is used to let<nl>higher life live.<end>Surveys from the Mars bases<nl>revealed great stores of water<nl>frozen underground...<nl>and that made the plan real at a<nl>stroke.<end>Today it goes forward under the<nl>phrases 'a green land on the red<nl>planet' and 'the new colony on<nl>Mars'...<nl>and as its first step, the solar<nl>mirrors are to be set in place in<nl>2045.<end>The 'Beagle Jerusalem', carrying<nl>the first Mars survey migrants,<nl>was launched the other day.
75acd5111178: <cmd6>'Bio-communication'<end>Communication without language, by<nl>detecting the chemical substances<nl>and other reactions a living body<nl>gives off and turning them into<nl>signals.<nl>In time, communication between<nl>mankind and other species is hoped<nl>for...<end>but for ethical reasons it runs<nl>one way at present: humans<nl>observing and surveying other<nl>creatures.<end>As for how consciousness works in<nl>vertebrates...<end>together with the results of PET<nl>scans of brain activity, it is now<nl>all but understood.
152419597f31: <cmd6>A living museum of genes, housing<nl>protected animals, including<nl>genetically engineered creatures<nl>and revived extinct species.<end>The International Union for<nl>Conservation of Nature (IUCN)<nl>established it to protect,<nl>restore, and breed endangered<nl>mammals, birds, and other animals.<nl>In addition to keeping live<nl>animals, it stores frozen genetic<nl>material from all kinds of<nl>species.<end>The successful natural birth of a<nl>baby unicorn in 2042 drew<nl>widespread attention.<end>The baby unicorn has also become<nl>Neo Kobe's mascot.
cc81e023637a: <cmd6>A musical performed by humanoid<nl>robots.<end>Each robot's expressions and<nl>movements are sampled from real<nl>actors, so the playing is no<nl>different from the real thing.<nl>The robot musical owes its<nl>popularity to this: change the<nl>software and every performance<nl>runs without a hair out of place,<end>and the playing of all sorts of<nl>actors can be reproduced.<end>Or else the playing and dancing of<nl>great actors now dead can be<nl>brought back.<end>Here in '42 the one still<nl>running and running is... 'The<nl>Phantom of the Opera'.
040bc42d4d14: <cmd6>Pets developed from modified<nl>marsupials that can also serve as<nl>purses.<end>The added value of a pet that<nl>doubles as a bag made them a big<nl>hit in the 2040s.<end>They first appeared in a<nl>commercial for a different<nl>purpose. Media attention then<nl>sparked a huge craze for Purse<nl>Pets.<end>Several companies disputed the<nl>copyright to Purse Pets at the<nl>time.<end>Complaints from an animal welfare<nl>association in 2041 briefly<nl>dampened their popularity.<end>
ed81ee3adc80: <cmd6>A food said to have been born when<nl>a student dropped the filling of<nl>an okonomiyaki into a pot of<nl>broth.<end>The way it floats up in the broth,<nl>crossed with the name of Neo Kobe,<nl>gave it its name.<end>Depending on what goes inside,<nl>Kobe-yaki of every kind is<nl>everywhere.<end>Today Kobe-yaki draws admirers<nl>across the country as a new food<nl>culture of Kansai.
f415fba76a5d: <cmd6>Aero surfing needs only<nl>protectors, an aero surfing<nl>board...<end>and a simple air wave system, so<nl>anyone can enjoy it...<end>and it caught on above all among<nl>the young of the slums.<end>The waves can be tuned freely and<nl>it can be done in any season, so<nl>meetings are held all over.
228aa5c7e952: <cmd6>A sport using winged horses<nl>created by gene manipulation.<end>A high-society sport that came<nl>from England; the contest is in<nl>gliding distance and gliding time.<end>The winged dragon horse is about<nl>the size of a small pony, and<nl>biology puts its flight at some<nl>fifty metres.<nl>In Neo Kobe the first official<nl>meeting was held on an offshore<nl>plant in '40.<end>The official winning record of<nl>that first meeting: eighty metres<nl>flown, thirty seconds aloft. An<nl>invited horse from abroad, of the<nl>Oracion Highlander breed.
5fb96fad1bd2: <cmd6>Alarmed by Snatcher infiltration,<nl>the government designated Neo Kobe<nl>City a contaminated area. The<nl>cabinet ordered all land and sea<nl>routes closed except for Neo Kobe<nl>Bridge.<end>The policy took effect on December<nl>1, 2042.<end>This prevented Snatchers from<nl>spreading elsewhere but deepened<nl>the city's isolation.<end>The Snatcher problem remains<nl>fundamentally unresolved.
e3bf02fbf566: <cmd6>Since its 2020 declaration as a<nl>multiethnic city, Neo Kobe has<nl>attracted immigrants of many<nl>ethnicities and races. This<nl>inevitably divided society and<nl>created a gap between rich and<nl>poor.<end>Wealthy, established residents<nl>live mainly around the government<nl>district in the North.
